title: Aokigahara standard GLB terrain exports

georeference.axisConvention: x east, y up, z south
georeference.forward: Project WGS84 lon/lat into local CRS as E,N; x=E,z=-N,y=GSI elevationM-900
georeference.inverse: Transform local CRS E=x,N=-z to WGS84; elevationM=y+900
georeference.elevationReference: GSI published numerical elevation reference, not ellipsoid height

exports.format: glTF 2.0 binary; all geometry and JPEG images embedded; no extensions

georeference.axisConvention: x east, y up, z south

georeference.inverse: Transform local CRS E=x,N=-z to WGS84; elevationM=y+900
georeference.elevationReference: GSI published numerical elevation reference, not ellipsoid height

interpretationLimits: Surface only; no cave interiors, trees, paths, water excavation, buildings or procedural ground displacement.
DEM input sampling: local approximately 8 m, study approximately 38 x 36 m, regional approximately 62.5 x 58.6 m. Grids carry the measured sources and their disclosed resampling limits.

Aerial texture depicts canopy/land surface at mixed acquisition dates. Leaf litter is representative CC0 material, not captured at this location. Outside aerial coverage, colours are an elevation-derived visual palette.
Geographic reference is recorded in standard glTF extras and companion manifest; glTF itself does not mandate a geographic CRS.

sources.fidelity: Representative photographic texture, not captured at Aokigahara

recommendedUse: Use Surface Terrain for continuous local-to-regional scene. Use Regional Terrain as a standalone alternative; do not overlay both complete meshes.
stitchMethod: Delaunay triangulation of retained local samples, study samples outside local bounds, and regional samples outside study bounds. Boundary gaps are bridged by triangles between existing measured samples; no elevation flattening or invented displacement.
runtimeOverride: Find material Local_Ground_CC0_Representative or nodes Local_Ground_* for nearfield PBR replacement. TEXCOORD_0 is x/1.26,z/1.26; other materials have geographic aerial UVs or no UV.
